title: Understanding Your NDIS Plan
excerpt: A plain-language walkthrough of NDIS plan categories and how to use them.
body: Your NDIS plan lists funded supports across categories such as Core, Capacity Building and Capital. Understanding these categories helps you make confident choices about providers and services. Speak with your support coordinator or planner if any part of your plan is unclear.

title: Choosing the Right Support Worker
excerpt: What to look for when matching with a support worker who fits your needs.
body: A good match considers your personality, communication style, cultural background and specific support needs. Ask about experience, training and availability, and request a meet-and-greet before committing to ongoing support.
